Descriptions.ShortDescription: Post-sequence telemetry analysis and multi-format (MD & HTML) diagnostic reporting.
Descriptions.LongDescription: Overnight Capture Diagnostics (OCD) is a lightweight, sequence-only N.I.N.A. plugin that analyzes session log files upon sequence completion. It calculates optical metrics (HFR, star counts), guiding performance, meridian flip diagnostics, autofocus thermal focus slopes, plate solves, and polar alignment telemetry (supporting TPPA and 2PPA), generating offline Markdown and dark-mode HTML reports.
